thread:
Alex Chen: hey team — first day here. Need access to our AWS org billing console and to link a couple GCP projects to the EU billing account. Who should I ping?
Maria Onb: welcome Alex! pinging @lindsay-iam and @samir-cloud. Can you file the access form? https://go/redwood/access-requests
Alex Chen: done — request 2026-01. Quick q: on AWS, do I need AWSBillingReadOnlyAccess or AdminRead to see org billing? On GCP, Billing Account Viewer vs Billing Account User?
Lindsay IAM: AWS: AWSBillingReadOnlyAccess is fine for reading invoices. If you need to attach payment methods, you need org-level Billing permissions (org billing admin). We usually add people to group 'org-billing-read'. For GCP: Billing Account Viewer lets you see billing accounts; Billing Account User is needed to link a project to a billing account.
Samir Cloud: also note some projects are locked to certain folders. List the projects you need and regions (eu-west1 etc.) so I can pre-check quotas/constraints.
Alex Chen: need projects: redwood-prod-dataflow (eu-west1) and redwood-prod-inference (us-west2). Will be setting up Dataflow jobs and temp buckets.
Samir Cloud: got it. I'll start the IAM change and the billing link. @cloud-bot create ticket
cloud-bot: New ticket created: AI-342 — 'Access request: Alex Chen — AWS billing + GCP billing link'. Assigned to Samir Cloud.
Lindsay IAM: FYI — Okta -> AWS -> Switch role flow is in the onboarding doc: https://go/redwood/docs/okta-aws. For gcloud, run: `gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-prod-dataflow --billing-account=0000-AAAA-BBBB` once you're added as Billing Account User.
Maria Onb: :thumbsup: we'll try to get this within the day. Samir, any ETA?
Samir Cloud: aiming for 4 hours for AWS group add, ~12-24h for GCP billing link (needs Billing Admin confirmation). I'll update AI-342.
Alex Chen: one more: what's the EU billing account ID? I saw two in the form.
Lindsay IAM: EU account is 0000-EURO-1111. I'll add a note to the ticket and mark it required for EU projects.
Alex Chen: perfect, thanks everyone!
